TICKET_ID=$(printf '%s' "$CREATE" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])')
echo "TICKET_ID=$TICKET_ID"
COMMENT_CODE=$(curl -s -D /tmp/t07_h.txt -o /tmp/t07_c.json -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"body":"Reproduced on staging.","author":"sam"}' "$BASE/api/tickets/$TICKET_ID/comments")
echo "COMMENT_CODE=$COMMENT_CODE"
cat /tmp/t07_c.json; echo
grep -i Location /tmp/t07_h.txt
curl -s "$BASE/api/tickets/$TICKET_ID" | tee /tmp/t07_d.json; echo
python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/tmp/t07_d.json")); assert len(d["comments"])==1 and d["comments"][0]["body"]=="Reproduced on staging."; print("detail OK")'
MISS=$(curl -s -o /tmp/t07_m.json -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"body":"x"}' "$BASE/api/tickets/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/comments")
echo "MISS=$MISS"; cat /tmp/t07_m.json; echo
curl -s -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"body":"Second note"}' "$BASE/api/tickets/$TICKET_ID/comments" >/dev/null
python3 -c 'import json,urllib.request; d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://localhost:8081/api/tickets/'"$TICKET_ID"'")); assert [c["body"] for c in d["comments"]]==["Reproduced on staging.","Second note"]; print("order OK")'
echo SMOKE_OK
